scope: Exact checked-in source target closure for the V8 Temporal dependency path. It includes ordinary and build dependencies described by pinned GN cargo_crate targets. It does not prove exact prebuilt library linkage for the downloaded Deno executable.
method: Traverse deps and build_deps labels in pinned cargo_crate BUILD.gn blocks, starting at temporal_capi/v0_2:lib; crate metadata and full license-text paths come from exact README.chromium files and vendor paths in the same fixed archive.

buildModeCaveat: rusty_v8 build.rs can either invoke the checked-in GN source build when V8_FROM_SOURCE is set or download prebuilt libraries; GN_ARGS and EXTRA_GN_ARGS can override flags. The exact environment and generated GN graph used for the packaged deno.exe are not recorded. Therefore this is the supported source-build dependency set, not a final binary SBOM.
noticeCaveat: All referenced license texts are preserved from the pinned third_party/rust subtree, and electron-builder packages docs/release/licenses under resources/licenses. A broad dependency closure and exact public binary notices still require review.
